en: Black‑and‑white postal card with printed stamp and official markings. The right side shows a boxed printed indicium with three crowns above the denomination "öre 040 öre" and the word "SVERIGE" beneath, along with several handwritten signatures. There is a round postmark from Malmö dated 12 VI 42 and a rectangular reception stamp dated 15 SEP 1942. The left side is mostly blank except for typewritten and handwritten notations.
